script_text: This week, Aries, your ruling planet Mars squares Pluto in your 10th House of career, and your fire element demands action. Monday and Tuesday are rough as the Sun in Scorpio, your 8th House of money, opposes Uranus in your 2nd House—expect surprise expenses. Wednesday softens when Mercury in Scorpio sextiles Venus entering your 7th House of love, sparking an honest talk with a partner. The mid-week turning point arrives Thursday as Mars moves from your 4th House of home into your 5th House of romance. Friday through Sunday, the Sun trines Neptune in your 12th House, making the weekend best for solitude and creative work. Thursday is your power day because Mars enters your 5th House and ignites your love life. Saturday is your worst day because the Moon squares Saturn in your 12th House, draining your energy. Start your passion project before Sunday. Follow for daily updates.
